subject.title: improve(telegram): align QA coverage with startup behavior

question: Should QA scenario execution-profile metadata be the permanent single owner of smoke-CI membership instead of the planner's fixed scenario list?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and validated, but this intentionally changes the long-term ownership boundary for release-gating automation; a maintainer should explicitly accept that contract.

options.title: Accept catalog-owned membership
options.body: Merge the current approach and keep the exact-membership tests as the CI contract for the four smoke jobs.

options.title: Retain planner-owned membership
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the fixed selection in the planner if maintainers do not want scenario metadata to control release-gate membership.

recommendation.title: Accept catalog-owned membership
recommendation.body: Merge the current approach and keep the exact-membership tests as the CI contract for the four smoke jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked report and the implementation, so they are the closest available routing contact for the intended QA ownership boundary.
